user_education_organization_check.name: user_education_organization_check
user_education_organization_check.value: "user_education"."organization_id" IS NOT NULL OR "user_education"."institution_name" IS NOT NULL

user_professional_experience_organizatio.name: user_professional_experience_organization_check

users_email_normalization_check.name: users_email_normalization_check

users_email_changed_check.name: users_email_changed_check

refresh_families_revoked_state_check.name: refresh_families_revoked_state_check

user_authenticators_revoked_state_check.name: user_authenticators_revoked_state_check

user_roles_revocation_coherence.name: user_roles_revocation_coherence
user_roles_revocation_coherence.value: "user_roles"."revoked_by" IS NULL OR "user_roles"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL

ck_citizens_verified_state.name: ck_citizens_verified_state
ck_citizens_verified_state.value:
"citizens"."civil_status" != 'verified'
        OR (
          "citizens"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "citizens"."verified_by" IS NOT NULL
        )

ck_identity_docs_verified_state.name: ck_identity_docs_verified_state
ck_identity_docs_verified_state.value:
"identity_documents"."verification_status" != 'verified'
        OR (
          "identity_documents"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "identity_documents"."verified_by" IS NOT NULL
        )

ck_identity_docs_dates.name: ck_identity_docs_dates
ck_identity_docs_dates.value:
"identity_documents"."issued_at" IS NULL
        OR "identity_documents"."expires_at" IS NULL
        OR "identity_documents"."expires_at" > "identity_documents"."issued_at"

ck_kyc_verifications_temporal_order.name: ck_kyc_verifications_temporal_order
ck_kyc_verifications_temporal_order.value:
("kyc_verifications"."completed_at" IS NULL OR "kyc_verifications"."completed_at" >= "kyc_verifications"."started_at")
        AND ("kyc_verifications"."expires_at" IS NULL OR "kyc_verifications"."completed_at" IS NULL OR "kyc_verifications"."expires_at" > "kyc_verifications"."completed_at")

ck_smart_contracts_address.name: ck_smart_contracts_address
ck_smart_contracts_address.value:
"smart_contracts"."address" LIKE '0x%'
        AND length("smart_contracts"."address") = 42
        AND substr("smart_contracts"."address", 3) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-Fa-f]*'

ck_smart_contracts_deployment_tx_hash.name: ck_smart_contracts_deployment_tx_hash
ck_smart_contracts_deployment_tx_hash.value:
"smart_contracts"."deployment_tx_hash" IS NULL
        OR (
          "smart_contracts"."deployment_tx_hash" LIKE '0x%'
          AND length("smart_contracts"."deployment_tx_hash") = 66
          AND substr("smart_contracts"."deployment_tx_hash", 3)
              NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-Fa-f]*'
        )

ck_wallets_internal_key_reference.name: ck_wallets_internal_key_reference
ck_wallets_internal_key_reference.value:
"wallets"."provenance" != 'internal'
        OR "wallets"."control_mode" = 'contract_controller'
        OR (
          "wallets"."key_provider" IS NOT NULL
          AND length(trim("wallets"."key_provider")) > 0
          AND "wallets"."key_reference" IS NOT NULL
          AND length(trim("wallets"."key_reference")) > 0
        )

ck_wallets_external_key_reference.name: ck_wallets_external_key_reference
ck_wallets_external_key_reference.value:
"wallets"."provenance" != 'external'
        OR (
          "wallets"."key_provider" IS NULL
          AND "wallets"."key_reference" IS NULL
        )

ck_wallets_address.name: ck_wallets_address
ck_wallets_address.value:
"wallets"."address" LIKE '0x%'
        AND length("wallets"."address") = 42
        AND substr("wallets"."address", 3) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-Fa-f]*'

ck_wallets_address_normalized.name: ck_wallets_address_normalized
ck_wallets_address_normalized.value:
"wallets"."address_normalized" LIKE '0x%'
        AND length("wallets"."address_normalized") = 42
        AND substr("wallets"."address_normalized", 3)
            NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-Fa-f]*'

ck_wallets_verified_state.name: ck_wallets_verified_state
ck_wallets_verified_state.value:
"wallets"."verification_status" != 'verified'
        OR (
          "wallets"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "wallets"."verification_method" IS NOT NULL
          AND "wallets"."last_ownership_verified_at" IS NOT NULL
        )

ck_wallets_unlinked_state.name: ck_wallets_unlinked_state
ck_wallets_unlinked_state.value:
"wallets"."status" != 'unlinked'
        OR (
          "wallets"."provenance" = 'external'
          AND "wallets"."is_primary" = false
          AND "wallets"."unlinked_at" IS NOT NULL
        )

ck_wallets_control_mode.name: ck_wallets_control_mode
ck_wallets_control_mode.value:
(
          "wallets"."provenance" = 'internal'
          AND "wallets"."wallet_type" = 'eoa'
          AND "wallets"."control_mode" = 'platform_key'
        )
        OR (
          "wallets"."provenance" = 'external'
          AND "wallets"."wallet_type" = 'eoa'
          AND "wallets"."control_mode" = 'external_user'
        )
        OR (
          "wallets"."wallet_type" = 'smart_contract'
          AND "wallets"."control_mode" = 'contract_controller'
        )

ck_web3_transactions_hash.name: ck_web3_transactions_hash
ck_web3_transactions_hash.value:
"web3_transactions"."tx_hash" IS NULL
        OR (
          "web3_transactions"."tx_hash" LIKE '0x%'
          AND length("web3_transactions"."tx_hash") = 66
          AND substr("web3_transactions"."tx_hash", 3)
              NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-Fa-f]*'
        )

ck_web3_transactions_to_address.name: ck_web3_transactions_to_address
ck_web3_transactions_to_address.value:
"web3_transactions"."to_address" IS NULL
        OR (

          AND length("web3_transactions"."to_address") = 42
          AND substr("web3_transactions"."to_address", 3)
              NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-Fa-f]*'
        )

ck_web3_transactions_data.name: ck_web3_transactions_data
ck_web3_transactions_data.value:
"web3_transactions"."data" IS NULL
        OR (
          "web3_transactions"."data" LIKE '0x%'
          AND length("web3_transactions"."data") >= 2
          AND (length("web3_transactions"."data") - 2) % 2 = 0
          AND substr("web3_transactions"."data", 3)
              NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-Fa-f]*'
        )

ck_web3_transactions_gas_limit.name: ck_web3_transactions_gas_limit
ck_web3_transactions_gas_limit.value:
"web3_transactions"."gas_limit" IS NULL
        OR (
          "web3_transactions"."gas_limit" <> ''
          AND ltrim(
            "web3_transactions"."gas_limit",
            '0123456789'
          ) = ''
          AND (
            "web3_transactions"."gas_limit" = '0'
            OR ltrim(
              "web3_transactions"."gas_limit",
              '0'
            ) = "web3_transactions"."gas_limit"
          )
        )

ck_web3_transactions_submitted_hash.name: ck_web3_transactions_submitted_hash
ck_web3_transactions_submitted_hash.value:
"web3_transactions"."status" NOT IN (
          'submitted',
          'pending',
          'confirmed',
          'dropped',
          'replaced'
        )
        OR "web3_transactions"."tx_hash" IS NOT NULL

ck_web3_transactions_signed_nonce.name: ck_web3_transactions_signed_nonce
ck_web3_transactions_signed_nonce.value:
"web3_transactions"."status" NOT IN (
          'signed',
          'submitted',
          'pending',
          'confirmed',
          'dropped',
          'replaced'
        )
        OR "web3_transactions"."nonce" IS NOT NULL

ck_web3_transactions_submitted_at.name: ck_web3_transactions_submitted_at
ck_web3_transactions_submitted_at.value:
"web3_transactions"."status" NOT IN (
          'submitted',
          'pending',
          'confirmed',
          'dropped',
          'replaced'
        )
        OR "web3_transactions"."submitted_at" IS NOT NULL

ck_web3_transactions_confirmed_state.name: ck_web3_transactions_confirmed_state
ck_web3_transactions_confirmed_state.value:
"web3_transactions"."status" != 'confirmed'
        OR (
          "web3_transactions"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "web3_transactions"."block_number" IS NOT NULL
          AND "web3_transactions"."block_hash" IS NOT NULL
          AND "web3_transactions"."receipt_status" IS NOT NULL
        )

ck_web3_transactions_block_hash.name: ck_web3_transactions_block_hash
ck_web3_transactions_block_hash.value:
"web3_transactions"."block_hash" IS NULL
        OR (
          "web3_transactions"."block_hash" LIKE '0x%'
          AND length("web3_transactions"."block_hash") = 66
          AND substr("web3_transactions"."block_hash", 3)
              NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-Fa-f]*'
        )

ck_web3_transactions_replacement_state.name: ck_web3_transactions_replacement_state
ck_web3_transactions_replacement_state.value:
"web3_transactions"."status" != 'replaced'
        OR (
          "web3_transactions"."nonce" IS NOT NULL
          AND "web3_transactions"."replacement_of_transaction_id" IS NOT NULL
        )

ck_financial_accounts_owner_rule.name: ck_financial_accounts_owner_rule
ck_financial_accounts_owner_rule.value: ("financial_accounts"."account_type" = 'user_available' AND "financial_accounts"."user_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("financial_accounts"."account_type" != 'user_available' AND "financial_accounts"."user_id" IS NULL)
